text_html:
Bass OS - Product focused Android OS for x86_64v2 based off Bliss OS source.

We add configuration options, boot parameters, features, apps, APIs and fixes to help solidify the Android-x86/Bliss OS source and prepare it for products.

Learn more at: http://bliss-bass.blisscolabs.dev
